title: Hot Smoked Peruvian Chicken Aji-De-Gallina
description: A hearty, flavorful Peruvian dish with the rich flavors of hot smoked paprika and a creamy ají de gallina sauce, served in a traditional kazán cauldron.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together hot smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken breast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a large kazán cauldron over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
In the same cauldron, sauté the diced ají amarillo peppers until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the cream of chicken soup and stir until it's well combined with the peppers.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 2 minutes.
Shred the cooked chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and add it to the cauldron.
Stir in the shredded gruyère cheese until it's fully incorporated.
Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve the hot smoked Peruvian chicken Aji-De-Gallina in the traditional kazán cauldron, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
